claim_boundary: P4-L offline success would establish only a bounded product alias projection for three already-extractable explicit drink scopes. It cannot establish open-domain multilingual ontology alignment, arbitrary recall, long-dialogue reliability, felt understanding, LLM superiority or a human equation.
